en: Color postcard showing a modernist hotel building set among trees with a large rooftop sign reading 'HOTEL NUFĂRUL'. The reverse side is printed 'CARTE POȘTALĂ', bears a green 'POȘTA ROMÂNĂ 40 BANI' stamp with a BĂILE FELIX postmark dated 29.VII.72, includes printed details 'BĂILE FELIX – Hotel "Nufărul"', price 'Lei 1,90', and a handwritten Romanian message and address to București.
